items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: Like one of my teachers was Reggie Workman.

ctx.x: Because of the geographical thing, not because of a talent thing or anything like that. They’re just not — you’ve got to move where the food is or else you’re going to be hungry. It’s simple. You know so many people have said that, like, “I’m hungry.” And I’m like, “you need to go where the food is.” You know? And then they don’t want to take the sacrifice to do it and it can be hard. But luckily if there’s school it takes some of that padding out, it makes it less hard, because of school. And then when you’re…
